features.text: PostModel: Parametric Modeling， Create a Entity with size and located in ... (POST /3d/root)
DeleteNodes: Delete nodes from scene,nodes are addressed by Object Addressing Path (DELETE /3d/nodes)
PostCreate: Create new file with specified format. (POST /3d/new)
PostConvertByFormat: Convert file on server to other formats with fileformat parameter (POST /3d/saveas/newformat)
PostConvertByOpt: Convert file on server to other formats with saveOption parameter (POST /3d/saveas/saveoption)
PostSaveAsPart: Convert part of the file into different format (POST /3d/saveas/part)
GetAllFileFormats: Get all fileformat in detail (GET /3d/fileformats)
PostPdfRawData: Extract raw data(without any modification) from a password protected PDF file (POST /3d/extract/rawdata)
PostSceneToFile: Extract and save in different format (POST /3d/extract/scene)
PostTriangulateNew: Triangulate whole file and save to the different file (POST /3d/triangulate/new)
PostTriangulateOriginal: Triangulate whole file and save to original file (POST /3d/triangulate/original)
PostTriangulatePart: Triangulate part of the scene(Specified by OAP) and save the scene to different file (POST /3d/triangulate/part)
